title.zh: 基于深度学习的图像识别系统

summary.zh: CNN 训练、评估与网页在线识别一体化系统。
summary.en: An all-in-one system for CNN training, evaluation and online web recognition.

description.zh: 基于 PyTorch 实现 ResNet 迁移学习，提供数据集管理、训练曲线可视化与模型评估，并通过 Flask 网页上传图片即可在线识别。
description.en: Transfer learning with ResNet in PyTorch, including dataset management, training-curve visualisation and evaluation. Upload an image in the Flask web UI to get predictions instantly.

zh: 混淆矩阵与准确率评估
